changes.summary: Added Top One Futures, Earn2Trade, Funded Futures Family, TradeDay and FTMO Futures (beta) presets.

Funded Futures Family changed Premier+ contract limits and added a 40% payout consistency rule on funded accounts bought on or after September 9, 2026. Accounts bought earlier keep their original terms.
Top One Futures launched Instant Sim Funded 2.0 for accounts bought on or after July 27, 2026: larger drawdowns on the 100K and 150K, a new daily loss limit on the 150K, and new payout caps.
TradeDay added a 45% payout consistency rule to Fast Pass funded accounts opened on or after July 26, 2026. Accounts opened earlier have no consistency rule.
Top One Futures tightened the Elite Daily evaluation consistency rule from 45% to 40% for accounts bought on or after May 11, 2026.
